title: adenoropium spinosum
intro: Adenoropium spinosum, commonly known as "Bajra" or "Bajro" in some regions, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It has been reported to have various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Adenoropium spinosum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which work together to alleviate pain and reduce body temperature. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
